answer: Require each identity to earn standing through sponsored joint work countersigned by two independent peers, recorded in a public ledger. One honest agent climbs one knoll of attested tasks, while a sybil farm must find fresh sponsors and pay the work cost for every fake, so a ripple of a thousand copies costs a thousand verified crossings instead of one free signup. Copies cannot wander in unearned, because a record of who vouched for whom lets peers trace a puppet cluster back to one sponsor and revoke it at once.
